title: Braking on a Curve
body: The driver of a car moving at $$90.0\, \tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}}$$ presses down on the brake as the car enters a circular curve of radius $$150.0\, \text{m}$$. $$The$$ $$speed$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$car$$ $$is$$ $$decreasing$$ $$at$$ $$a$$ $$rate$$ $$of$$ $$9.0\, \tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}}$$ each second.
lesson: 4. Motion in Two and Three Dimensions
